window.start_rule: Start at each team's 2026 training-camp report/check-in date and include pre-existing injuries that affected camp participation.

include_if: expected starter or meaningful rotational player
injury can materially change teammate fantasy opportunity
injury can materially change team offense or defense
injury can materially change DST sacks/interceptions/fumble-recovery/TD/points-allowed expectation
injury can materially change spread, total or player-prop distribution
population_scope.exclude_only_if: Player has no plausible pathway to fantasy, team efficiency, DST, spread/total or prop output. Exclusion must be reviewable, not assumed from position alone.

chronology_rule: Record every meaningful injury/recovery/PUP/NFI/IR/practice-return event. Preserve history but resolve one current state; latest verified state wins unless credible sources conflict.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Alec Pierce
newly_caught_examples.reason: Ankle/heel issue carried from 2025, March surgery, missed offseason work, opened camp on Active/PUP, activated Aug. 27 and still required ramp-up toward Week 1.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Malik Nabers
newly_caught_examples.reason: 2025 ACL plus offseason cleanup procedure; avoided PUP, later returned to limited full-speed team work but remained in a ramp-up state.

newly_caught_examples.subject: George Kittle
newly_caught_examples.reason: Entered camp on PUP during Achilles recovery and remained uncertain for Week 1; absence/ramp materially affects 49ers passing efficiency and target distribution.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Micah Parsons
newly_caught_examples.reason: ACL plus meniscus rehab; confirmed expected to miss start of season with target around mid-October.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Braxton Jones
newly_caught_examples.reason: Lead LT left camp practice injured but reportedly avoided major injury; Week 1 health affects protection and run efficiency.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Coby Bryant
newly_caught_examples.reason: Knee injury adds uncertainty to a secondary already replacing starters.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Austin Jackson
newly_caught_examples.reason: Key starting RT missed camp time with injury; absence would materially affect Miami protection and rushing efficiency.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Rene Konga
newly_caught_examples.reason: Reported out for entire 2026 season; defensive front availability must be reflected in the adjusted defensive prior.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Roy Robertson-Harris
newly_caught_examples.reason: Torn Achilles during offseason work; especially relevant after other defensive-line turnover.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Nick Bosa
newly_caught_examples.reason: Returning from 2025 ACL; availability and effectiveness at season start affect pressure-based defensive expectations.

newly_caught_examples.subject: Fred Warner
newly_caught_examples.reason: Entered 2026 returning from a major ankle injury but was reported good to go; preserve recovery history without current penalty unless new evidence changes state.

qa_requirements: All 32 teams reviewed from camp opening through current date.
Every fantasy-relevant player reviewed, even if currently healthy after an earlier injury.
Every expected-starting or materially rotational OL and defensive player reviewed for injury history/current state.
Opening PUP/NFI/IR and pre-camp surgeries are included.
Camp and preseason injuries are included.
Recovery/activation events are included so stale injury flags are not carried forward.
Current-state resolution is separated from historical injury chronology.
No numeric model movement occurs from a headline alone; only authorized deterministic availability rules or validated coefficients may move projections.
